label: Trim layer
intent: The layer's out-point is trimmed. Light: the out-point handle drives in 6 and stops dead a little past its mark; the clip's end follows it 50 ms later, shortening the layer, and both settle. Strong: the handle first pulls back, then slams in well past its mark, rebounds and settles; the clip's end follows each beat. The time ruler never moves; the preview reset fades it back.

bar.//: trim 0 = v1's 18-long layer, 1 = its 12-long result; the driver passes 1 for the overshoot

trim.//: the clip end is pulled by the handle: same beats, 50 ms behind
